records.title: Elementary Khmer
records.text: KHMER 111 Elementary Khmer (5) Provides necessary communication skills in standard spoken and written Khmer. Covers a variety of topics including introductions and pleasantries, elementary vocabulary, classroom activities, the family, and Khmer lifestyles. First in a sequence of three. Maximum 15 credits allowed between KHMER 111; KHMER 112; KHMER 113; and KHMER 134.

records.title: Elementary Khmer
records.text: KHMER 112 Elementary Khmer (5) Provides basic communication skills in standard spoken and written Khmer on a variety of topics including foods, directions and transportation, occupations, work, and getting things done. Second in a sequence of three. Maximum 15 credits allowed between KHMER 111; KHMER 112; KHMER 113; and KHMER 134. Prerequisite: KHMER 111.

records.title: Elementary Khmer
records.text: KHMER 113 Elementary Khmer (5) Leads students to the intermediate level of communication skills in standard spoken and written Khmer on an additional variety of topics. Topics include health, illness, religion, weather, and necessary living tasks such as renting a hotel room, and purchasing or wearing clothing. Third in a sequence of three. Maximum 15 credits allowed between KHMER 111; KHMER 112; KHMER 113; and KHMER 134. Prerequisite: KHMER 112.

records.title: Intensive Elementary Khmer
records.text: KHMER 134 Intensive Elementary Khmer (15) Provides students with a foundational proficiency in standard spoken Khmer, with an emphasis on functional communication and culturally informed language use. Through daily practice, students develop basic listening and speaking skills across a range of everyday topics, including personal background, interests and hobbies, travel, and common occupations. Maximum 15 credits allowed between KHMER 111; KHMER 112; KHMER 113; and KHMER 134.

records.title: Intermediate Khmer
records.text: KHMER 211 Intermediate Khmer (5) A&H Brings students beyond elementary level Khmer to an intermediate level of speaking, listening, reading, and writing proficiency on a variety of topics, including religion, traditional village culture, and news and public information. Helps students to adapt to a particular way of behaving and speaking appropriate to the Khmer language. First in a sequence of three. Prerequisite: KHMER 113.

records.title: Intermediate Khmer
records.text: KHMER 212 Intermediate Khmer (5) A&H Brings students beyond elementary level Khmer to an intermediate level of speaking, listening, reading, and writing proficiency on a variety of topics, including the language of public information and living in the contemporary capital city (Phnom Penh) in Cambodia. Second in a sequence of three. Prerequisite: KHMER 211.

records.title: Intermediate Khmer
records.text: KHMER 213 Intermediate Khmer (5) A&H Brings students beyond elementary level Khmer to an intermediate level of speaking, listening, reading, and writing proficiency on a variety of topics, including Khmer history and politics, and Khmer literature. Includes reading modern short novels and discussions. Third in a sequence of three. Prerequisite: KHMER 212.

records.title: Advanced Khmer
records.text: KHMER 311 Advanced Khmer (5) A&H Brings students beyond the intermediate level of speaking, listening, reading, and writing.
